claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Acitretin at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; retinoid receptor agonism modulates differentiation and gene expression rather than directly killing cells, and no class in the vocabulary shares a retinoid-driven killing pattern.
